title: Fresh Approval and Executor Selection Hold
claim: FP-MCP-313 recorded and validated a fresh approval, but stopped before clearance because the operator selected the adjacent preflight observer instead of the enforced executor. No clearance, enablement, or canary run occurred.
summary: FP-MCP-313 approval APPROVAL-20260704T162359975Z-16d7dc66 was recorded, committed at 3e0bd41, and validated usable. The intended next tool was forgepilot_apply_guarded_canary_next_gate. Instead, forgepilot_get_guarded_start_preflight_report was selected. The call was read-only. Operator trace TRACE-20260704T162503174Z-7bd30e98 was recorded and committed at 4eb1cc7.
